compiled_state.description:
## Testing Mode
RED

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: Schema migration sentinel `v1.2.0` added to a new migration script; backward-compat: tickets lacking `## Closure Checks` section are treated as having an empty section (pass, not fail)

## Implementation

Create `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-migrate-closure-checks-v1.sh` following the pattern of `ticket-migrate-file-impact-v1.sh` and `ticket-migrate-brainstorm-tags.sh`:

**Script responsibilities:**
1. Accept `--target <host-project-root>` and `--dry-run` flags
2. Check for plugin-source-repo guard (no tickets tracker dir = skip with NOTICE)
3. Check for idempotency marker: `.claude/.closure-checks-migration-v1` — if present, exit 0 immediately
4. Scan all epic and story tickets in the tickets tracker
5. For each ticket: if `## Closure Checks` section is ABSENT from the description, append it after `## Success Criteria`
6. Backward-compat: tickets already containing `## Closure Checks` are left unchanged
7. Write idempotency marker `.claude/.closure-checks-migration-v1` on completion
8. `--dry-run`: print what would change, write no files, set no marker

**Section insertion:** Use the same ticket-description-update pattern as existing migration scripts — write a new description event via the ticket CLI or direct event writing (follow the pattern in ticket-migrate-file-impact-v1.sh).

**Naming conventions:**
- Script: `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-migrate-closure-checks-v1.sh`
- Marker: `$REPO_ROOT/.claude/.closure-checks-migration-v1`
- Author in migration events: `ticket-migrate-closure-checks-v1`
- Env ID in migration events: `00000000-0000-4000-8000-migration002`

## Pattern Reference
See `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-migrate-brainstorm-tags.sh` lines 71-80 for the marker-file idempotency pattern.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0) — specifically test-ticket-migrate-closure-checks-v1.sh PASSES
  Verify: bash tests/scripts/test-ticket-migrate-closure-checks-v1.sh
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && eval "$LINT_CMD"
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(bash .claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && eval "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD"
- [ ] Script is executable (chmod +x)
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-migrate-closure-checks-v1.sh
- [ ] Idempotency: running script twice produces no additional changes on second run
- [ ] Dry-run: `--dry-run` flag writes no files (covered by test cases)

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
